explanation: Fires almost only in the original phase (99% of mass) at steps 1-3 (step 2 holds 60% of mass), and almost only when the input is the letter i (83% of mass, 24x lift). The letter n accounts for most of the rest (13%). It never fires at t=0 or at t>=6. How likely it is to fire, and how strongly, depends on which tokens came before. The strongest activations are i at step 2 after prefixes k m, k 2, k o or 2 m, and first_tok k, o or 2 has about 4x lift. Prefixes with b, 0, y, z, x, q, d or v usually leave it silent. A bare i at steps 1-3 rule gets mass recall 0.82 but precision only 0.25. Adding the condition that one of k/2/o/m/u/w/t/r/e/p came earlier raises precision to about 0.46 with the same mass recall. The context dependence is graded rather than a clean token set, so precision stays incomplete. Delimiter and copy steps are rare and weak.
